name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Private research: rail-style station binding on ordinary tramtrack. Engine support is unproven.
description: Revision 8 adds UM Track-bound Stop (Test), a separate 80m through stop built entirely from ordinary electric tram STREET edges. Uses the rail station convention vehicleNode={-1,1} to target a root edge endpoint directly. This convention is confirmed in native rail station scripts but NOT confirmed for STREET tram templates. First test: place one stop on a separate save and inspect logs before building a line. No internal vehicle lane geometry, opposite duplicate edges, custom track templates, hidden loop or commands. Existing prototype station scripts remain unchanged from the recovery build. This is not a working metro or proof of native reversal. Keep the pre-crash save; do not use revision 6 (0.2.2).
